nodes.label: AI Candidates Workflow
nodes.rationale: Decouples AI output from the manuscript by treating generations as editable candidates. Unaccepted candidates and model reasoning tokens are kept separate and never enter manuscript or future story memory without explicit author approval.

nodes.label: Azure Waters Promise
nodes.rationale: Lightweight AI novel-writing tool for Android long-form fiction inspired by SillyTavern-style context management. Built on the core principle that the manuscript belongs to the author and AI only offers possibilities without silently overwriting story text.

nodes.label: Creative Dialogue Assistant
nodes.rationale: Provides an independent conversational assistant per novel for brainstorming character motivation and plot conflicts without altering the manuscript or carrying intermediate reasoning into dialogue turns.

nodes.label: Creative Trail and Pre-Send Inspection
nodes.rationale: Promotes transparency and auditability by allowing pre-send review of prompt structure, memory order, and redacted requests, while recording generation history, token usage progress rings, and reversible text additions.

nodes.label: Password-Protected Encrypted Backup
nodes.rationale: Single-file .ainovelbackup package secured with user-provided password using authenticated encryption (AES-GCM), supporting complete project migration, restoration, and pre-restore rollback without cloud dependency.

nodes.label: Focused Manuscript Editing
nodes.rationale: Maintains continuous manuscript text auto-saved on device, with collapsed chapter details to maximize screen space for writing, supporting chapter creation, ordering, recycling, and soft restoration.

nodes.label: Multi-Provider Model Integration
nodes.rationale: Integrates diverse LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, Vertex AI, Kimi, Qwen, GLM, MiniMax, xAI, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow) with support for API keys, OAuth2 Service Account JSON, and custom endpoints.

nodes.label: Story Memory and Lorebook System
nodes.rationale: Maintains long-term narrative consistency via selectable chapter context, layered summaries with source-change tracking, presets, and lorebooks. Global inspiration materials are strictly opt-in per project.

nodes.label: Android Tech Stack Architecture
nodes.rationale: Standard native Android stack using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Room database, DataStore, OkHttp streaming, and Android Keystore AES-GCM encryption.

nodes.label: AI 候选工作流
nodes.rationale: AI 生成内容先进入多候选队列，支持对比、修改与重新生成。未采纳内容与思考过程绝不污染正文或后续记忆，仅在确认后追加。

nodes.label: 绀海之约
nodes.rationale: 面向长篇小说创作的 Android 本地优先 AI 创作工具，借鉴酒馆式上下文管理体验，坚持正文属于作者、AI 仅提供可能的核心理念。

nodes.label: 灵感对谈助手
nodes.rationale: 每部作品拥有独立的灵感对话助手，专注探讨人设、情节冲突和叙事走向，不擅自修改正文，也不跨轮次携带思考过程。

nodes.label: 创作足迹与检查
nodes.rationale: 发送前提供上下文脱敏检查与参数确认，创作足迹记录模型原稿、作者修改、候选状态与 Token 环形进度，支持安全撤回正文追加。

nodes.label: 带密码的加密备份系统
nodes.norm_label: 带密码的加密备份系统
nodes.rationale: 通过用户自定义密码对单文件 .ainovelbackup 进行认证加密，完整打包小说、封面、章节、模型配置与历史，支持备份恢复前回滚。

nodes.label: 专注正文编辑
nodes.rationale: 正文自动保存于本机，默认折叠章节信息以最大化正文展示空间，支持章节排序、回收、恢复及软键盘弹出时的可视编辑优化。

nodes.label: 多模型供应商适配
nodes.rationale: 适配主流国内外大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，特别支持 Google Gemini 与 Vertex AI 服务账号 JSON 自动签发 OAuth2 凭证。

nodes.label: 故事记忆与设定系统
nodes.rationale: 通过可选章节记忆、分层总结（带来源变化检测）、预设和世界书维系长篇连贯性，全局素材仅在主动复制启用后参与提示词组装。

nodes.label: 原生 Android 技术栈
nodes.rationale: 采用 Kotlin、Jetpack Compose、Room、DataStore、OkHttp 与 Android Keystore (AES-GCM) 构筑的高性能本地优先移动架构。

nodes.label: Local-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Ensures privacy and reliability by storing novels, chapters, lore, summaries, candidates, and history primarily in local SQLite/Room database and app-private storage. Network requests are only made when explicitly triggering online model generation.

nodes.label: 本地优先架构
nodes.rationale: 所有作品、章节、设定、总结、候选与历史记录均优先保存在本地设备中，无需联网即可写作，确保数据自主可控与隐私安全。
